_readme: Titles: honorifics and ranks a lady can hold (js/logic/titles.js). She can hold several (w.titles); the one she goes by (w.titleId, picked on her sheet) is shown with her name and gives its perk. Titles stay with her through New Game+.

label: how it reads. after: true = shown after her name ('Mira, Belle of Hollowmere'), otherwise in front ('Captain Rinna'). desc: the perk, in words (sheet tooltip and the 'earned a title' log line). fx: merged into the effect engine like a trait's (vocabulary: the _readme of traits.json).

How a title is gained: seed (only from data: characters.json / guests.json 'title', the label or the id), earn (checked weekly, then earnChance per week), event (granted by a random event in js/events/random.js, wording in events.json → title_<id>), arc: '<lady key>' (granted when her romance arc in arcs.json completes), house: '<house id>' (granted to the house's resident when its story completes). A title she already holds (or has grown past) is skipped. A title can have several of these.

Tiers: from: [title ids] makes this title an upgrade of those. Gaining it replaces them (her held list drops the lesser title, and if she went by it she now goes by the new one), so a lady holds one title per line. An earn title with from needs one of them first (Captain -> Dame -> Grand Warden), unless open: true. Arc, house, event and seed titles with from are unique upgrades: they need nothing first but still replace (Lady Vesper -> Vesper, Lady of the Manor). A title can branch into several (Lady -> Baroness / Countess / Lady of the Manor). The tier (shown as stars on her sheet) is 1 + the highest tier it upgrades from; an upgrade's perk should beat what it replaces.
Retired ids: renamedTitles maps an old id to the title that replaced it (old saves are converted on load).
earn uses the traits.json earn conditions ({count, at}, {stat, at}, {trust}, {lewd}, {weeks}, {job, weeks}) plus {reborn: n} (carried over n times) and {all: [conditions]} (every one must hold).
Creator ladies: a free-text title that matches a label here becomes that title (with its perk); anything else is a custom title with no perk.
